integrity: Finite case enumeration is exhaustive over 42 partition types and separately cross-checked by fixed-point formulas; independently externally audited results are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Odd characteristic only; zeta functions of the theta schemes, not of the curve; two branch-partition pairs are inherently indistinguishable; unindexed equivalent older orbit tables may exist.
title: Two persistent Frobenius ambiguities in the genus-four hyperelliptic spin schemes, and a sharp five-extension recovery theorem
